canon.name: Kaiju Attack
canon.frame: hyperrealistic handheld footage from right inside a colossal creature's attack on a real coastal city, the camera low and close to the action wherever it stands, the creature immense in the frame
canon.still: The ground shakes and the camera at street level tilts up the avenue as the creature smashes through the towers at the far end in a storm of glass and concrete dust, rears up and roars a towering column of orange fire into the sky while cars jolt and crowds run past the camera, and in the last second the camera holds steady on the whole avenue as the dust drifts
canon.approach: In the first half second, the camera swings fast toward {thing} and pushes in
canon.arrive: the camera is swept along with the attack in one huge rushing move and lands in {thing}
canon.settle: In the last second, the camera comes to rest and holds steady on a clear wide view of where it now stands, the creature and every thing in its place while smoke drifts
canon.ambient: Air raid sirens wail, the creature's footsteps boom and rumble, car alarms whoop and crowds shout in the distance
canon.selectSound: A huge booming orchestral hit from a disaster film score
canon.lettering: neat condensed sans in crisp white, medium weight, Title Case
canon.style: hyperrealistic IMAX disaster film footage, natural color

ladder.mood: a frightening, realistic giant monster attack, the city terrified and the army on alert
the army rolls in with tanks, jets and ever bigger weapons
ladder.ambient: Searchlights sweep the smoke and tank columns rumble through the streets behind the creature
ladder.sound: A booming voice on a loudspeaker orders everyone to evacuate

ladder.mood: the creature is unstoppable and the destruction grows enormous
ladder.ambient: Fires and towering smoke columns rise from blocks across the city
ladder.sound: The creature lets out a deep earth shaking bellow

ladder.mood: giants arrive to fight: a steel robot, jet squadrons, a second creature from the harbor
ladder.ambient: A squadron of fighter jets streaks low between the towers trailing smoke
ladder.sound: Fighter jets scream overhead in a tight formation

ladder.mood: the battle becomes an enormous spectacle across the whole city
ladder.ambient: Flares and fireworks of tracer fire light up the sky over the harbor
ladder.sound: A full orchestra thunders a huge disaster film climax

ladder.mood: the giants make peace and the city throws them a ticker tape parade
ladder.ambient: Confetti and ticker tape rain down between the towers
ladder.sound: A marching band plays and a huge crowd cheers

filler: Every frame looks like real photographed footage of a real city
Real scale everywhere: tiny people, cars and boats against the giant
Natural daylight glints off glass, water and the creature's wet scarred hide
Billowing concrete dust and drifting smoke hang in the air
Crowds of real people run and look up in every direction
Physical, photographic detail fills every surface
Natural colors, deep shadows and real atmospheric haze
Edges are crisp and the picture is sharp from edge to edge
Every scene is framed like a disaster film shot with the creature leading
Each thing sits apart on its own side of the view with open space between
The creature moves with enormous real weight
The creature's dorsal spines glow orange from within
Printed words are rare, small and neat in crisp white condensed sans
The camera ends every move steady, holding a clear view of the scene
